facts.text: It was the location of Bast Castle, a fortress used by Count Dooku, and later a place where Darth Vader studied the dark side of the Force.

evidence.quote: It was the location of Bast Castle, a fortress used by Count Dooku, and later a place where Darth Vader studied the dark side of the Force.

facts.text: After the fall of the Sith Empire, Vjun was one of the refuges for the Sith.

evidence.quote: After the fall of the Sith Empire, Vjun was one of the refuges for the Sith.

facts.text: Droids such as the FIII Footman droid and the R2-series astromech droid were used as the workhorses of the Vjun population as they were rather more resilient to the highly acidic climate.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Vjun was located within Separatist space.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Vjun was located within Separatist space.

facts.text: Before this, it was where Darth Vader's personal fortress, Bast Castle, resided.

evidence.quote: Before this, it was where Darth Vader's personal fortress, Bast Castle, resided.

facts.text: It had concentrated acid rain and the fortress was well guarded by many of Vader's best troops, including the legendary Dark troopers.

evidence.quote: It had concentrated acid rain and the fortress was well guarded by many of Vader's best troops, including the legendary Dark troopers.

facts.text: During the later phases of the Galactic Civil War, the clone trooper-turned Jedi X2 led New Republic forces to Bast Castle in the Battle of Vjun in order to find his brother, X1, now a Sith Lord.

evidence.quote: During the later phases of the Galactic Civil War, the clone trooper-turned Jedi X2 led New Republic forces to Bast Castle in the Battle of Vjun in order to find his brother, X1, now a Sith Lord.

facts.text: Kam Solusar trained as a Dark Side Elite on Vjun before Luke Skywalker turned him to the light-side on Nespis VIII, six years after the Battle of Endor.
